sam: Heads upstarter app stalls on first call after accept-invite. curl -> 402 Payment Required on /v1/chat/completions. anyone seen this? :confused:

maya: which workspace/sample?

sam: org: org_zoe-qa, sample: js-starter-app. repro curl below:

sam: ```curl -X POST https://api.redwood-inference.example/v1/chat/completions -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"model":"redwood-3b","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"hello"}]}'
# => HTTP/1.1 402 Payment Required
# {"error":"workspace_payment_required","message":"Attach payment method or enable trial"}```

devon: 402 not a 403, so billing gating. did you Accept via SSO invite or direct email?

sam: invite after SSO. I didn't see any trial CTA in console after accept.

maya: console occasionally suppresses trial CTA for SSO-provisioned pools. filing ticket.

jules (billing): confirmed org_zoe-qa has no payment method and trial=false. known gap: SSO invite flow sometimes fails to flip trial. can flip it for you now.

sam: please, need to run CI smoke tests.

jules (billing): done ":trial enabled for org_zoe-qa. you should be unblocked in ~30s."

sam: re-run success! :tada: 200 and tokens consumed.

sam: notes for follow-up: 1) surface trial CTA for SSO-invite 2) API error should hint to console path (/console/orgs/org_zoe-qa/billing) 3) map 402 to SDK BillingRequiredError not generic HTTPError

maya: added devex follow-up: CLI helper `redwood orgs enable-trial <org>` (admins only) + README note in starter app about billing gating.

sam: tagging @platform-sre FYI in case routing needs tweaks. :wave:

onboard-bot: case #4732 created: "SSO invite suppresses trial CTA" assignees: maya, console-team. priority: P2."
